name: smwmusic-the-price-is-right-sax
title: The Price Is Right (Sax Version)
description:
Theme song for the UK version of The Price Is Right with Bruce Forsyth. As heard in pixlrik's precision hack "The Precise Is Right".

This theme was used in the Bruce Forsyth version (UK 1995), as well as The New Price Is Right (US 1994), and possibly others. The naming of syndications and spin-offs of The Price Is Right is extremely confusing, but this is the jazzy one with the epic saxophone solo.

Uses samples from PlayerSounds '23 and Super Bonk.
